name: Silence Mobs
summary: Name a mob with a name tag reading 'Silence me' to stop it making sounds, and 'Unsilence me' to restore its sound.

mechanics.title: How it works
mechanics.description: Rename a name tag in an anvil to 'Silence me', 'silence me', 'Silence Me' or 'silence_me' and use it on a mob. The nearest mob with that name within 16 blocks becomes Silent; it glows for 3 seconds with a chime and is briefly named 'silenced'. The name is removed after about 3 seconds. 'Unsilence me' (also 'unsilence me', 'Unsilence Me', 'unsilence_me') reverses it.

qol: Quiet noisy farm animals or villagers.
commands_and_keybinds: No commands: use an anvil-renamed name tag on the mob.
getting_started: Rename a name tag to 'Silence me' in an anvil, then right-click the mob with it.
editor_notes: The mob ends up unnamed afterwards, so a silenced mob cannot keep a custom name via this pack.
